# VeeVee Luscious

> Luxury bath and body care — whipped body butters, sugar body scrubs, handmade bath bars, massage oils and men's grooming, made to nourish skin and elevate everyday self-care.

VeeVee Luscious is a handcrafted bath and body brand. Products are made in small batches with nourishing ingredients and sold directly through this site, including single items and curated collections.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Brand story, best sellers and the Luscious As You Wanna Be experience.
- [Shop](/shop): Body butters, sugar scrubs, bath bars, massage oils and men's grooming, with sizes and pricing.
- [Bundles](/bundles): Curated collections, limited edition sets and monthly subscription boxes.
- [Cart](/cart): Review your selections and check out with flat-rate shipping.
